target_customer: Small and medium construction companies in Latin America, starting in Colombia
problem: Small contractors overpay for materials and run back office work on spreadsheets; HippoBuild pools demand to buy from large manufacturers and provides an ERP and financing options.
business_model: Small SaaS fee plus a 1% transaction fee on materials sourced (company says 20K to 100K dollars per customer)
product_category: Construction ERP and materials procurement marketplace

founders.name: Mads Schmidt Petersen
founders.background_notes: Serial entrepreneur with about 8 years of product development in construction tech, fintech and machine learning services per YC page; employers and education not stated.

founders.name: Alberto Gonzalez
founders.background_notes: Forbes Colombia (Feb 2022) says the company was cofounded by Colombian Alberto Gonzalez; another directory lists him as CTO.

competitors.name: Procore
competitors.what: Construction project management platform leading the category, ranked first in a 2021 industry report
competitors.traction_then: public company, completed Levelset acquisition by early 2022
competitors.funding_then: about 500M raised over 15 rounds per CB Insights

competitors.name: Buildertrend
competitors.what: Construction management software for residential builders and remodelers
competitors.funding_then: growth investment from Bain Capital Tech Opportunities and HGGC

technical_complexity.rationale: ERP workflows and marketplace integrations are standard; the harder parts are supplier integrations and procurement operations.

defensibility.rationale: Pooled purchasing volume and ERP data could create stickiness, but a five person team and generic software are easy to copy; no evidence of scale.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The cited competitors served US customers; no source shows them targeting Latin American SME contractors.

market_need_then: The company claims small contractors lack IT tools and overpay for materials; Construction Dive reported record contech funding in 2021 but no source here quantifies LatAm SME spend.

identity.logo: Hippo themed per the name; logo not described in sources
identity.voice_and_tone: Practical Spanish language messaging: el aliado de los constructores

brand_strength.rationale: Memorable animal name but shared with unrelated Hippo companies (insurer Hippo), and no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: HippoBuild is a five person Bogota based startup selling construction ERP software and pooled materials purchasing to small contractors, listed Active in the YC directory. Funding figures are aggregator only and conflict, and no revenue or customer count was found, so there is not enough public evidence to say whether it is succeeding or stalled.
notes: Unverified funding: Startup Intros lists a 700K seed in August 2021; CB Insights lists about 500K with REACH LATAM, ScaleUp, YC, BBQ Capital, NAR REACH. Not recorded as rounds. One directory lists Alberto Gonzalez Rouille as CTO; not on the YC page, so not listed as a founder. Company hosts a Notion financial data page that was not opened. Competitors listed are US category leaders, as no LatAm competitor with a 2021 to 2022 source was found. Completeness pass: Forbes Colombia (Feb 2022) reports 500K from Y Combinator plus named angels without amounts; Startup Intros alone reports a 700K seed in Aug 2021. CB Insights total is about 500K. The two may overlap, so amounts are not summed. Alberto Gonzalez added as co-founder per Forbes Colombia.
